name: Tender Coconut Payasam (Elaneer Payasam)
description: A refreshing and creamy South Indian dessert drink made with tender coconut, milk, and cardamom. Lightly sweet with natural coconut flavors, best served chilled.
directions: Scoop out the tender coconut flesh and chop into small pieces or blend partially for a creamy texture.
Blend grated coconut with tender coconut water and extract thick coconut milk.
Boil the whole milk in a pan and let it simmer until slightly reduced.
Add condensed milk and sugar, stirring continuously until dissolved and slightly thickened.
Add crushed cardamom pods for flavor.
Pour in the extracted coconut milk and mix gently.
Add tender coconut pieces and stir.
Heat ghee in a small pan and roast cashews until golden, then add to the payasam.
Cool to room temperature and refrigerate before serving chilled.
